title: Almanac article body
description: S22: one file per full_text_ok article, bodies/<article_id>.json (R12, DESIGN-v1.1 section 3). body_html is exactly what the feed's own item gave, content:encoded when the feed carries one and it clears the full-text length test, otherwise description; never a fetched article page. Raw HTML is fine here, S37's sanitizer runs at render time, not at write time. Closed shape: an unknown field is a contract change, not a silent addition.

article_id.description: Matches the article's id in pool.json, and the filename this record is written as.

source_name.description: Source attribution, shown next to the body by the reader (S25).

url.description: The canonical link out to the source's own article.

body_html.description: Raw HTML (or plain text) exactly as the feed gave it. Untrusted until S37 sanitizes it at render time.
